name: Heroism
summary: Makes a willing creature immune to fear and gives it Temporary Hit Points each turn.

stats.effect: A willing creature you touch is imbued with bravery. Until the spell ends, the creature is immune to the {ref:condition/frightened} condition and gains {ref:glossary/temporary-hit-points} equal to your spellcasting ability modifier at the start of each of its turns.
stats.higherLevels: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.
